# Debt Master

> Self-hosted web app that tracks shared lunch expenses in workplace teams. Admins record lunches and payments; colleagues check exactly what they owe by signing in with an access code. Free and open source under the MIT license.

Pricing: $0, no paid tier. You run it on your own server; expense data never leaves it.

## FAQ

### What is Debt Master?
A free, self-hosted web app that tracks shared lunch expenses in a workplace team. Admins record lunches and payments; colleagues check what they owe by signing in with an access code.

### Do my colleagues need accounts?
No. Colleagues sign in with an access code issued by their admin. Only admins need email and password.

### Where does our data live?
On your own server. Debt Master is self-hosted, so expenses, names, and balances never leave the machine you run it on.

### What does it cost?
Nothing. Debt Master is open source under the MIT license, so you run it yourself for free.
